analyst_view.overall: Go Ahead Eagles (8th, 17 pts) host Fortuna Sittard (7th, 20 pts), who have drawn five of their last six, most recently 2-2 at home to Telstar. Fortuna are badly hit: Sports Mole says Rodrigo Guth, Edouard Michut, Lequincio Zeefuik, Daley Sinkgraven and Ole Romeny all missed the Telstar game and Ramazan Bayram is out long-term; the brief lists no Fortuna absences, so the numbers only see them through recent form. Mohamed Ihattaren (four goals, four assists) carries their attack, and Go Ahead plan to have Meulensteen shadow him; a Fortuna fan site also reports coach Danny Buijs will not extend his contract. Go Ahead have Margaret and Galvez back from international duty, Cillessen in goal for Marsman, and Waayers and Saathof out, as the numbers know. Referee Martijn Vos (4.6 cards a game) is already a large part of the cards number.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals. Fortuna are without forwards Romeny and Zeefuik and midfielder Michut, none of whom the numbers take off, and have scored only 8 in their last six (partly counted). Guth missing at centre-back weakens their defence, which pulls the other way, so I trim to about 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 10.5 corners, already cut a little for Fortuna's low recent count (20 in six). Go Ahead should press and push down the wings as usual at De Adelaarshorst, and Fortuna's absences are already showing in that low count, so I stay at 10.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.7 cards: Martijn Vos's very high card rate (+40%) pushes it up, while Go Ahead's 4 cards in their last six (the league's cleanest side, per Deventer Voetbal) and Fortuna's low count pull it down, all already counted. Man-marking Ihattaren could bring a few fouls, but no bans or flashpoints are reported, so I stay at 3.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.6 shots. Fortuna's shooting is down recently (64 in six, counted) and they are still missing several first-choice attackers the numbers don't list, with Descotte expected up front, so I lean lower to about 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.7 shots on target. With Romeny, Zeefuik and Michut out and Ihattaren left to carry the attack, Fortuna should test Cillessen less than the numbers assume; about 9.3.
